records.subject: Still want to get Pioneer Dynamics set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

We haven't seen much activity on Pioneer Dynamics' account yet. If priorities shifted, no worries -- but if you're still interested, I'm glad to help you get moving.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for the note -- we're still deciding if this is the right tool for our team, give it another week.

Jordan

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Hope the first few days with Wrenfield have been smooth. If you'd like, I can help you set up a first project so you're not starting from a blank page.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Pioneer Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Pioneer Dynamics* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Customer explicitly deferred evaluation by a week [email:7e521c5d], and day 6 of 14 with no project, no invite, no milestone despite two prior touches [email:e2239f3f, email:620f52af]. Pro plan and active status give some chance of self-start inside the 8 remaining days, but stated intent points to delay past day 14.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the straight answer — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield fits your team. I won't crowd your inbox in the meantime.

One thing that often helps the evaluation: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real project in Wrenfield usually tells you more than a demo would. If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a short call this week to walk through that with you — otherwise I'll check back after your week is up.

Best,
Priya
